Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Everything you need to know about our real estate mailing service, from proof of mailing to pricing.

faqs.q: Is proof of mailing included with tenant notice mailing?
faqs.a: Yes — every letter includes affidavit of mailing from Postalocity proving items were processed and handed to USPS. Upgrade to Certificate of Mailing for official USPS documentation or Certified Mail for full USPS tracking with delivery confirmation.

faqs.q: Does the property management mailing service include address verification?
faqs.a: Yes. Every address is validated through USPS CASS-certified verification before printing. This catches inaccurate addresses and reduces returned mail, ensuring your tenant communications reach the right mailbox.

faqs.q: What's included in landlord mailing pricing?
faqs.a: Starts at $1.31 per letter. All pricing includes printing, folding, stuffing into #10 envelopes, sealing, postage, and mailing affidavit. No hidden fees for standard real estate mailing service operations.

faqs.q: How fast can I get tenant notices mailed?
faqs.a: Same-day production when approved by noon CT. For standard property management mailing, expect 1-3 business days for USPS delivery after approval. Expedited options available for urgent landlord mailing needs.

faqs.q: Can I mail to multiple properties at once?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our platform supports batch uploads for portfolio-scale landlord mailing. Upload addresses across your entire property portfolio and process all tenant notice mailing in a single workflow.
